requirements.claim: Guard and synchronization fields are trusted model assertions. A held unrelated lock bypasses the static permission check; TransferCustody{synchronized:true} merges clocks on a supplied Boolean.
requirements.rejection_mechanism: Not a diagnostic. crates/qcore-core/src/concurrency.rs:205 declares exactly one ConcurrencyProfile variant, TrustedExplicitTrace, stamped on every certificate at concurrency.rs:547. The reviewed acceptance row 'deny unrelated-lock access in a checked-invariant profile' names a checked-invariant profile that does not exist, so it is outside the admitted profile rather than a failing check. The boundary is carried as named certificate assumptions, not as a rejection: ConcurrencyAssumption::InitialAuthorityAndUniqueLifetimeIds, ::GuardFootprintAuthority and ::SynchronizedCustodyEdges, asserted exactly in the test above.
requirements.verified_sub_property: The review's required qualification ('the certificate must not be advertised as having established that premise') is verified-fixed: the empty program carries only InitialAuthorityAndUniqueLifetimeIds; a guarded access adds GuardFootprintAuthority; a synchronized transfer adds SynchronizedCustodyEdges; flipping synchronized to false makes check_concurrent reject. Existing same-mutex positive traces still pass, so the model was not 'repaired' by deleting mutex authorization.
requirements.remaining_boundary: Checked mutex-footprint invariants, guard-derived borrows, guard affinity and reconstructed synchronization witnesses remain open. Queued as HANDOFF H06 (W6/R03), targeting CT26-CT34/CT48 source execution; assumptions may be replaced only when independently proved.

requirements.claim: Maximum iteration evidence becomes exact final custody. summarize_general_loop forwards Terminating/Widened maxima to the exact n-fold bounded_loop; a maximum-count-two acquire body gets exact net two and does not cover the zero-iteration flow.
requirements.observed_semantics: LoopBoundEvidence now separates Exact / AtMost / Terminating / Widened / Unbounded (crates/qcore-core/src/resource_accounting.rs:15). For a nonzero-net body, AtMost/Terminating/Widened with bound >= 1 return Err(LoopSummaryError::NonExactCustody) across bounds 0..=2 and both net signs; bound 0 yields Flow::zero(). Mutating a valid Exact certificate to AtMost is rejected by check_loop_summary (NonExactCustody) and by loop_ledger_morphism (CategoryError::InvalidLoopSummary). Zero-net bodies keep AtMost and are proved to cover every actual iteration count 0..=bound; a forged summary is rejected with InvalidCertificate.
requirements.remaining_boundary: Exact counts remain supplied premises, not derived from source. The summary API carries no allocation-identity discharge claim (stated in-test at resource_accounting.rs:128-129). Identity alternatives and general source loops remain unsupported; the source driver still rejects source loops, so this stays a model/certificate contract.
